Type: lamp
Name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Contemporary Floor Lamp with Brushed Steel Accents, 63"H, Matte-Black
Colors: Matte Black
Materials: Metal
With a stunning contemporary design that will win over visitors, this LED floor lamp also saves you money and energy costs that will win over your wallet. Utilizing only 8.3-watts of energy, you have the perfect task light that adds style to any room! 8"W x 12"D x 63"H Metal shade and base in a matte-black finish with brushed steel accents Contemporary design meets modern styling, perfect for every room in your home Integrated LED Assemble in 15 minutes or less For indoor use only
